title: Jerez Tour and Tasting
text:
My partner and I had a wonderful time visiting the city of Jerez de la Frontera and tasting Sherry at Tio Pepe.  We were surprised how much we enjoyed the dry Sherry.  We had time to explore the town with our guide, do the tasting, and have lunch (not included).

Our guide, Francisco, was amazing!! He was knowledgeable, polite, and fun.  He kept saying that this was our tour and he could adjust to what we wanted to do with the free time.  We definitely recommend this tour, especially if Francisco is your guide.
author: skywalk235

title: Jerez and Tio Pepe wine tasting
text: Our guide, Miguel, was the best!  Very knowledgeable and personable. Jerez is a small city but still has much to offer the day tripper from Sevilla. The Tio Pepe tour was typical of similar types of tours we’ve done, but the guide we had there, Esther, was also very good and who can complain about sampling wines from Jerez (maybe not everyone’s taste). Highly recommended.
author: jontN1549RD

title: A pleasant day in Jerez
text: Miguel was an excellent driver and guide. A day trip to Jerez de la Frontera is a very pleasant day trip from Seville. The Tio Pepe complex is very impressive. The tour of the facility and the tasting took about 2 hours. One piece of advice….. pay the extra 4 euros at the tasting so you can samples 4 Jerez wines instead of just 2.
author: James_C

title: Tio Pepe Winery and Tasting Tour
text: Arrived at the meeting point on time. No one there for tour. They checked and we had paid and had a ticket with QR code. No driver had showed up, so after many phone calls, they found a driver. Luis, was an exceptional tour guide and because we were the only ones booked, he went out of his way to make our tour memorable. He even dropped us off at our rental apt. Thank you Luis for saving our day!
author: Daniela_V
